operators.name: glu_forward
semantics: Implements GLU along dimension 1: split input x of shape [B, 2*N, F] into a = x[:, :N, :], b = x[:, N:, :].
Computes output = a * sigmoid(b), shape [B, N, F].
Input must be contiguous and reside on CUDA; output allocated on same device with same dtype.
GLU along dim=1 splits into first 512 channels and second 512 channels.
Returns the GLU output tensor [1024, 512, 256] float32 on CUDA.
